verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents invoicing, per-client entities (Clients API), and a Reports API with 'seven types of reports' including Invoice Details and Payments Collected, implying customer-level transaction data is queryable, but no evidence explicitly names an accounts-receivable aging report or a dedicated per-customer balance view. Missing for 10: explicit aging-report feature documentation, explicit per-customer outstanding-balance report, and any UI/API confirmation of AR-specific terminology.
